instruction: Candid outdoor close-up photograph of a couple on a rocky coast. Under an overcast sky, the man with dark curly hair and glasses (R1), wearing a white long-sleeve shirt and a blue puffer vest, smiles widely in the center of the frame. He is carrying the woman with light brown hair (R2) on his back. The woman (R2), wearing a grey and green striped sweater, wraps her arms tightly around his chest from behind, her face resting near his shoulder with a happy expression. The camera captures them at eye-level with a shallow depth of field, softly blurring the green bushes in the background. The lighting is diffused and natural, casting soft shadows across their faces.
